parts.text: What should she expect after some days?

options.text: The shoot grows upward and the root grows downward.
The root keeps growing upward and the shoot keeps growing downward.
Both the root and the shoot grow sideways only, with no up or down direction.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Anaya grows a mustard seedling. She turns the pot so the seedling is upside down and leaves it in even light from all sides.

part_answers.answer: Even when a seedling is inverted, the shoot grows upward and the root grows downward.

teacher.key_rationale: Shoots grow upward and roots grow downward. An inverted start does not lock the root upward and the shoot downward; even light does not erase up/down growth.
